item.text:
Refactored the codebase to separate CLI concerns from the reusable search flow. [SearchRequestParser.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchRequestParser.java:1) now owns default input handling and `String[]` parsing, while [SearchResultFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchResultFormatter.java:1) owns output rendering.

That let me simplify [SearchApplication.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchApplication.java:1) so it only coordinates search and rendering for a `SearchRequest`, update [NaivePatternSearchCli.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchCli.java:1) to compose the parser and application explicitly, and remove duplicated formatting logic from [SearchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchResult.java:1). I also updated [NaivePatternSearchTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchTest.java:1) to verify the new parser and formatter boundaries.
